title: The Visible star of the evening
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：visible　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 visible 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the builder wrote of ① a visible star of the evening in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so visible that nobody in the site would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the visible ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the visible star of the evening that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too visible to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the visible ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a visible change in the village, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as visible as the change in the village they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was visible or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something visible, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite visible; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the visible ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, in public, she wrote of another visible star of the evening in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less visible than anybody had expected. ⑩ The visible change in the village that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the visible ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 看得见（前置定语 a visible star of the evening：1988 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件看得见的那颗星）
B. adj. 看得见／明显（两处加强说法：so visible that … 与 no less visible than …）
C. adj. 看得见／明显（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 看得见（表语 too visible to do：母亲觉得它太看得见，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 明显（前置定语 a visible change in the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩明显的变化）
F. adj. 明显（同级比较 as visible as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村子的明显变化相比）
G. adj. 明显（后置定语 something visible：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 明显（受程度副词修饰 quite visible：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a visible star of the evening
the visible star of the evening that
a visible change in the village
The visible change in the village that

answers.why: visible 意为“看得见”，1988 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件看得见的那颗星”，此处作前置定语 a visible star of the evening。
visible 意为“看得见”，此处用 so visible that 结构，说它看得见到工地里没人敢靠近。
visible 意为“看得见”，施工图上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的看得见傍晚看得见的那颗星，等于最高级的说法。
visible 意为“看得见”，母亲认为这件东西“太看得见了，谁也用不上”，too visible to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
visible 意为“明显”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩明显的变化”，此处作前置定语 a visible change in the village。
visible 意为“明显”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村子的明显变化一样明显”，同级比较用 as visible as。
visible 意为“明显”，施工图上那半行字要的是“明显的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something visible。
visible 意为“明显”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当明显”，quite 修饰原级 visible。
visible 意为“明显”，no less visible than 表示“其明显不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之明显不亚于任何人的预料。
visible 意为“明显”，母亲 2000 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的明显变化”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件看得见的那颗星。（a visible star of the evening）
它看得见到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so visible that …）
母亲觉得它太看得见，谁也用不上。（too visible to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩明显的变化。（a visible change in the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村子的明显变化一样明显。（as visible as …）
到了 1995 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件明显的东西。（something visible）
answers: In 1988 the builder wrote of a visible star of the evening in the plan.
It was so visible that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too visible to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a visible change in the village.
He said nobody would call it as visible as the change in the village they had once had.
By 1995 the plan asked for nothing but something visible.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 visible 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the builder wrote of a visible star of the evening in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the visible star of the evening that anybody there had ever seen, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too visible to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a visible change in the village, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite visible, and everybody laughed.
The visible ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
